tool_calls.input:
const cmd = `PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -c '
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime

baseline = "0c91b35e8d0e7b3a71904a49b017484e064640e5"
files = ("engine.lua", "mod-tome.lua", "tome-orcs.lua")
workset = json.loads(Path(".ai/task/repair-w56-20260929/WORKSET.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
loader = LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest()))
expected = {(x["normalized_path"], x["section"], x["source"], x.get("source_tag")): x for x in workset["items"]}
changed = []
summary = {}
for name in files:
    before_bytes = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", baseline + ":" + name])
    after_bytes = Path(name).read_bytes()
    before = loader.load_bytes(before_bytes, logical_path=name)
    after = loader.load_bytes(after_bytes, logical_path=name)
    assert len(before.records) == len(after.records), (name, len(before.records), len(after.records))
    file_changes = 0
    for old, new in zip(before.records, after.records):
        old_cmp = dict(old)
        new_cmp = dict(new)
        old_target = old_cmp.pop("target", None)
        new_target = new_cmp.pop("target", None)
        assert old_cmp == new_cmp, (name, old, new)
        if old_target != new_target:
            assert old.get("kind") == "translation"
            key = (name, old["section"], old["source"], old.get("source_tag"))
            assert key in expected, key
            assert old_target == expected[key]["target_preimage"], key
            changed.append({"file": name, "section": old["section"], "source": old["source"], "source_tag": old.get("source_tag"), "before": old_target, "after": new_target})
            file_changes += 1
    summary[name] = {"records": len(after.records), "translations": len(after.translations), "target_changes": file_changes, "sha256": after.sha256}
changed_keys = {(x["file"], x["section"], x["source"], x["source_tag"]) for x in changed}
assert len(changed) == 29, len(changed)
assert changed_keys == set(expected), (len(changed_keys), len(expected), set(expected) - changed_keys, changed_keys - set(expected))
assert {k: v["target_changes"] for k, v in summary.items()} == {"engine.lua": 1, "mod-tome.lua": 25, "tome-orcs.lua": 3}
payload = json.dumps(changed, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
print(json.dumps({"status": "pass", "baseline": baseline, "files": summary, "target_changes": len(changed), "workset_exact_match": True, "non_target_field_changes": 0, "other_records_unchanged": True, "translation_diff_sha256": hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
'`;
const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd,workdir:"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",yield_time_ms:30000,max_output_tokens:12000,sandbox_permissions:"require_escalated",justification:"允许我用 manifest-compatible LuaJIT 加载三份译文并相对冻结基线核验恰 29 条 target 变化吗？"}); text(r.output);
